title: Production Readiness Audit

evidence.claim: Canonical PR remains open/draft; branch is ahead of main and not yet released.
CI validates Python 3.11-3.13 on Linux and Python 3.12 on Windows using editable install; no built-wheel validation is present.
README still describes the repository as the initial v0.2 import and is stale relative to current canonical implementation.
Runtime version remains 0.1.0 and must be synchronized at release.
Repository visibility is public; code search found no obvious TODO/FIXME or token/password/secret patterns, but no dedicated security scanner gate exists.
Release blocker severity, warnings and deterministic remediation order are documented.
